title: Zero polynomial circuit language
statement: The language consists of encodings of pairs $(n,C)$ in which $C$ is a well-formed algebraic circuit on $n$ inputs and the polynomial computed by $C$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a natural number $n$ and an algebraic circuit $C$ on $n$ inputs
The encoding of $(n,C)$ equals the given string
The polynomial computed by $C$ equals zero
